# Getty Images

> > Getty Images is the world's leading provider of royalty-free stock photos, creative imagery, and generative AI tools for commercial and editorial use.

Getty Images offers a comprehensive digital library of high-resolution stock photos, vectors, and videos across news, fashion, entertainment, and cultural content. The platform provides both traditional image licensing and cutting-edge generative AI capabilities for commercially safe image creation and modification.

## Key Topics

- stock photos
- royalty-free images
- generative AI
- image licensing
- high-resolution imagery
- editorial content
- creative content
- video footage
- celebrity photography
- media management
- image search
- subscription plans
- commercial licensing
- vector graphics
- holiday imagery

## Core Products & Services

- [Getty Images Homepage](https://www.gettyimages.com): Main portal for royalty-free stock photos, creative images, vectors, and news, fashion, and entertainment imagery
- [Generative AI by Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai): Commercially safe AI image generation and modification technology for creating custom visuals
- [Creative Images Collection](https://www.gettyimages.com/creative-images): Curated collection of royalty-free photos and editorial content across multiple categories
- [Stock Photos Library](https://www.gettyimages.com/creative-images/stock-photos): Comprehensive stock photos collection available in multiple sizes and formats

## Pricing & Account Management

- [Plans and Pricing](https://www.gettyimages.com/plans-and-pricing): Subscription plans and download pricing for stock images, videos, and UltraPacks
- [Sign In](https://www.gettyimages.com/sign-in): User authentication and account login for Getty Images

## Popular & Trending Content

- [Most Popular Searches](https://www.gettyimages.com/most-popular-searches/united-states/images): Trending image searches and popular topics in the United States
- [Artificial Intelligence Imagery](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/ai): Stock photos and visuals related to artificial intelligence and machine learning
- [Family Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/family): Large collection of diverse family-themed imagery with over 5.7 million photos

## Holiday & Cultural Collections

- [Easter Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/easter): Comprehensive Easter holiday collection with seasonal and illustrative content
- [Easter Sunday Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/easter-sunday): Easter Sunday stock photos featuring holiday decorations and family moments
- [Good Friday Imagery](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/good-friday): Good Friday and Easter religious holiday stock photo collection
- [Women's History Month](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/womens-history-month): Women's History Month stock photos and cultural imagery
- [Passover Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/passover): Passover and Jewish holiday imagery including Seder and cultural content
- [Yom Haatzmaut Collection](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/yom-haatzmaut): Israel Independence Day and Yom Haatzmaut stock photo collection

## Design Resources & Technical Content

- [Paper Texture Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/paper-texture): Paper texture stock photos for design and background resources
- [Calendar Graphics](https://www.gettyimages.com/stock-photos/calendar): Calendar graphics and seasonal stock photos for design projects
- [Data Center Imagery](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/data-center): Data center and server infrastructure stock photography collection
